'''This''' was a method of storing information via an individual's DNA. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] and the agent [[Sarin (rebel agent)|Sarin]] journeyed to [[Feddasyr]] to retrieve a secret code hidden and stored in a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper's]] DNA.
